description: Get the current regulatory documents for a product — the official product label and safety data sheet (SDS) per registered market, with download URLs and versions. Labels are market-specific: always use the document for the market where the product will be applied.

region.description: Optional ISO alpha-2 market code (e.g. "gb", "ie") to fetch one market only.

name: get_product_documents
title: Get product documents (label / SDS)
